title: How does Pinnacle Blooms handle the separation anxiety of a child with Autism during therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Addressing Separation Anxiety during Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Dealing with separation anxiety in children with Autism through empathetic, gradual exposure during therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: Separation anxiety can be a challenging issue for children with Autism, and at Pinnacle Blooms, we understand the emotional stress it can cause. With the use of evidence-based strategies such as gradual introduction, positive reinforcement, and reassurance, our empathetic professionals help to ease the distress, making therapy a positive experience for your child.
